title: Tokyo police to set up autonomous driving unit to handle permits, accidents
key_facts: The Tokyo Metropolitan Police Department plans to establish a dedicated unit in April 2027.
The unit is to prepare for the spread of autonomous vehicles.
It will strengthen procedures for granting permits and develop methods to investigate accidents involving self-driving cars.
A photo caption says Waymo plans to begin commercial operation of driverless robotaxis in Tokyo in 2027.
